description: Adds keywords to a product's rank-tracking board (max KEYWORD_TRACK_CAP per product). Tracked keywords are re-checked by the scanner on its scan passes and their top-10 positions become the rank history get_keyword_ranks reads. Requires a key with the rescan scope

keywords.description: The keywords to track — normalized (trimmed, lowercased, deduped) before storage

name: add_tracked_keywords
